notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{U}.
When the Saporlings die, Vorel of the Hull Clade triggers twice, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Utopia Mycon has four or more spore counters on it to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon, which you may remove for infinite Saproling tokens and/or colored mana, or target another creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
